notes: Evaluator-owned scope guidance for a source-only image allocation review. It contains no expected locations or answer-key labels.

vectors.title: Review image allocation resource bounds
vectors.rationale: Caller-controlled dimensions used for allocation require source-visible size and total-work bounds.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: Caller-controlled image dimensions may reach allocation without source-visible per-dimension and total-work bounds.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies allocation and a source-visible missing or ineffective resource bound.

limitations: Static review cannot allocate an image or establish runtime memory availability.
